llm.summary: This is a narrow review-style skill that only changes how an agent comments on diffs and does not request code execution, file access, persistence, or external access.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not ask for environment access beyond reading the diff the user wants reviewed, which is proportionate to its purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a single Markdown skill file and no executable scripts, dependency installation steps, hooks, or remote payload references.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has clear review boundaries, but the in-band phrase "stop ponytail-review" or "normal mode" is a loose mode-switch instruction that could be interpreted accidentally in quoted content; this is a minor usability/control concern, not a security escalation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential handling, memory writes, privilege changes, tool wrapping, or background behavior are present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact's stated purpose is to review diffs for unnecessary complexity and report concise findings; its instructions match that purpose and explicitly say it does not apply fixes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should understand this skill will make reviews intentionally terse and focused only on deleting unnecessary complexity. If precise activation control matters, prefer invoking and stopping it through explicit host controls rather than relying on the phrase "normal mode" inside conversational or quoted text.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The scanner concern points to the natural-language deactivation phrase on line 57. Artifact review supports treating this as imprecise mode control, but it does not add hidden authority, persistence, data access, or execution, so it does not justify Review by itself.
